title: ponder - Legacy
body:
Bringing back the reflections from higher versions to 1.12.2

Enables you to use a feature similar to the higher version's contemplation functionality to visually display tutorials for players in 1.12.2.
The old version has ceased updates and has been fully migrated to the new version, which offers better performance, more streamlined editing, and improved support. To access the old version repository, please [click here](https://github.com/wu-xiao-ya/ponder-for-1.12.2). 
It is still in beta and not yet stable, but it is definitely usable.
For detailed usage instructions, please refer to the GitHub wiki.
Please provide feedback on GitHub if you encounter any problems.


将高版本的思索带回1.12.2
旧版本已停止更新，全面转向新版本，拥有更好的效果，更合理的编辑，更好的支持，如需前往旧版本仓库，请[点击这里](https://github.com/wu-xiao-ya/ponder-for-1.12.2)。
让你能够在1.12.2使用像高版本的思索功能为玩家**可视化**的展示教程
目前仍为测试版本，尚不稳定，但已一定可用。
具体使用方法参考github wiki。
有问题请前往github反馈。
